confidence_notes: Recent Boston city-price averages support the meal, coffee and beer anchors. Cocktail and wine estimates are less certain; wine is estimated from its usual price relationship to beer and reported local menu ranges. Accommodation is a holistic estimate from the supplied comparable-city prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: Boston's strong visitor, university and business demand suggests higher year-typical accommodation prices than the supplied Philadelphia and San Francisco examples. The estimates place basic rooms and three-star hotels above those comparisons, with hostel prices also somewhat higher.
